headingText: Sec. 12-4.5. Tampering with food, drugs or cosmetics.

blocks.text: Sec. 12-4.5. Tampering with food, drugs or cosmetics.

blocks.label: (a)
blocks.text: (a) A person who knowingly puts any substance capable of causing death or great bodily harm to a human being into any food, drug or cosmetic offered for sale or consumption commits tampering with food, drugs or cosmetics.

blocks.label: (b)
blocks.text: (b) Sentence. Tampering with food, drugs or cosmetics is a Class 2 felony.
